name: ui
note: The app's own panels at 2x: its lime title slab, the neighbourhood bar, a place's detail, the Seongsu walk's detail (distance, time, the places on the way) and its share dialog. In the share dialog the link's local capture address is replaced by the deployed address, and its length updated.

steps.js: (() => { const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('.side-panel button')].find(b => /목록/.test(b.textContent || b.getAttribute('aria-label') || '')); if (b) b.click(); })()
(() => { const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('.item--route .item__main')].find(b => /붉은벽돌 골목 한 바퀴/.test(b.textContent || b.getAttribute('aria-label') || '')); if (b) b.click(); })()

steps.name: route
steps.note: the walk's detail: distance, time, the places on the way

steps.js: (() => { const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('.side-panel button')].find(b => /공유/.test(b.textContent || b.getAttribute('aria-label') || '')); if (b) b.click(); })()

(() => { const dl = document.querySelector('dialog[open]'); if (!dl) return; const ta = dl.querySelector('textarea, input'); if (ta) { ta.value = ta.value.replace('http://capture.local/index.html', 'https://offgrid.toyz.kr/'); ta.scrollTop = 0; const n = ta.value.length.toLocaleString('en-US') + '자'; [...dl.querySelectorAll('*')].forEach(e => { if (e.children.length === 0 && /^[\d,]+자$/.test(e.textContent.trim())) e.textContent = n; }); } if (document.activeElement) document.activeElement.blur(); })()
steps.note: the link as it reads on the deployed app (https://offgrid.toyz.kr/), not the capture's local server
